camera: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI asset: one standalone magical archival camera emblem on a truly transparent background, square canvas, no text. A small antique bellows camera made of worn dark bronze and ivory bone, a luminous icy turquoise optical lens, an open cream-coloured old book at its base, and a few asymmetrical fine antique gold astronomical orbit lines around the lens. Hand-painted fantasy illustration with visible refined brushwork, thin intentional edges, material patina and muted ivory silver highlights; consistent with a dark teal winter ruined-library game. Strong irregular silhouette readable at 110px. Centered object occupies 76% of canvas, with plenty of transparent margin, nothing cut off. Front three-quarter view. Local soft lens glow only; the camera body and open pages are clear. No enclosing badge disk, no circular opaque black background, no card, no plaque, no square frame, no floor shadow, no text, no letters, no symbols resembling interface. Transparent outside the object and delicate orbit lines.
sigil: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI asset: one standalone ornate expedition sigil on a truly transparent background, square canvas, no text. A long slim dark sword pointing diagonally upward from lower left to upper right, threaded through an incomplete antiqued gold astrolabe ring with finely engraved celestial navigation arcs. A white-silver four-point compass star behind the sword's middle; a flowing low-brightness icy cyan aurora ribbon twists around the outer right edge, like torn silk or watercolour smoke. Sophisticated irregular asymmetric fantasy emblem; snowy ruined-library atmosphere, dark indigo, patinated antique gold, silver-white and pale icy turquoise. Hand-painted anime fantasy object art, careful metal edge highlights, visible brushwork, not shiny 3D. Overall shape fills 82% canvas with generous transparent margins. Keep the LOWER MIDDLE 35% of the canvas largely transparent and low detail so a separately rendered live title can sit in front. Fine orbit lines give a large recognizable arc, not a dense knot of spokes. No black disc or opaque background, no rectangular button or plaque, no frame, no text, no letters, no UI, no extra swords. Genuine alpha transparency outside the ornament.
